preconditions.description: The input string s has a length between 1 and 100 characters.
The input string s contains only digits.
The input string s represents a positive integer.

postconditions.description: The function returns the total number of ways to decode the input string s.

postconditions.description: The function returns the total number of ways to decode the input string s, where a valid encoding is one that corresponds to a letter in the alphabet.
